en.app.title: iOS Backup
en.app.subtitle: Back home on Wi-Fi — your iPhones & iPads back up automatically.
en.header.restartHint: Tap this if a device isn't detected: restarts the underlying USB & Wi-Fi connection service. Your backups are not affected.
en.empty.title: No devices yet
en.empty.subtitle: Three steps to your first backup — no technical terms required.
en.empty.s1b: Plug the iPhone / iPad into this machine with a cable, or put it on the same Wi-Fi.
en.empty.s2b: The device asks “Trust this computer?” — tap Trust and enter its passcode.
en.empty.s3t: 3 · Come back and tap “Back up now”
en.empty.s3b: The device appears below — one tap starts the backup. You can make it automatic afterwards.
en.progress.waitingAuthorizationHint: Check your iPhone and enter its passcode when prompted. This backup stops if the wait times out.
en.progress.waitingDeviceHint: Waiting for the device response. Preparing a large encrypted backup can take several minutes without changing the overall percentage.
en.progress.sendingHint: Sending data needed by the backup. Incremental backups first send the existing manifest.
en.progress.stalledHint: No backup activity was detected within the time limit, so this job stopped. Check device authorization and the network, then retry.
en.progress.preparingHint: Watch the iPhone for an authorization prompt and keep it ready to unlock.
en.progress.runningHint: Receiving backup data. Keep the device connection stable.
en.progress.overallOnlyHint: Reliable per-file byte counts are unavailable, so only overall progress is shown.
en.progress.currentFileHint: Progress of the file currently being transferred
en.progress.reconnectingTitle: Waiting for the device to reconnect
en.progress.reconnectingHint: Wi-Fi was interrupted. The last progress is preserved while waiting for the device.
en.progress.interruptedHint: The device stayed offline, so this backup stopped safely. Reconnect it to start a new backup.
en.progress.failedHint: Keep the device online and try again.
en.progress.storageHint: Check free space and write access for the backup location.
en.progress.lockedHint: Unlock the device and enter its passcode when prompted.
en.gate.offline: Device is offline — can't back up
en.gate.busy: Device is busy (a backup or operation is already running)
en.gate.notCharging: This device has “Only while charging” on — please plug it in and try again.
en.gate.lowBattery: Battery {b}% is below the set minimum {m}% — skipped
en.gate.backupBusy: Another device is backing up — please try again shortly.
en.menu.title: Menu
en.menu.onboardingHint: Connect, trust, and complete the first backup
en.menu.notifHint: Set up notifications for backup success, failure, and more
en.update.banner: A new version is available — click to refresh
en.migration.text: This device used to back up over Wi-Fi and is now offline. If it changed networks (and can't be auto-discovered), add its IP under Backup settings to keep backing up wirelessly.
en.bset.windowHint: Auto-backups run only inside this window (e.g. overnight).
en.bset.minBatteryHint: Skip auto-backups below this level so the device never runs flat.
en.bset.autoBackupHint: When off, you back up manually with “Back up now”.
en.bset.dirHint: The folder where backups are stored.
en.bset.ipPlaceholder: Leave blank — auto-found on the same Wi-Fi
en.bset.ipHint: Auto-discovered on the same Wi-Fi, so leave it blank. Only fill it in for a different subnet or Tailscale.
en.bset.passcodeNote: Due to iOS security, every backup asks for the device passcode when it starts. Keep the device unlockable during the backup window and enter it promptly, or this backup will stop after the waiting period.
en.bset.testOk: Device connected. Save settings to keep this IP.
en.bset.dirOk: Save location is usable — it takes effect after you save
en.bset.dirBad: Save location isn't usable — please enter another path
en.bset.offlineHelp: Device shows offline? ① Make sure it's awake and on the same Wi-Fi as this server. ② On the device, toggle Wi-Fi off/on (or switch Settings → Wi-Fi → ⓘ → Private Wi-Fi Address) to refresh its connection. ③ If you know its IP, enter it above and tap “Test connection”.
en.bset.pairHint: Needed on first connection: tap “Trust this computer” on the device.
en.bmgmt.filesNote: Visible on your LAN only — don't share.
en.bmgmt.deleteNote: Files inside a backup have hashed names and aren't directly browsable. Unpacking rebuilds them into a browsable folder copy by original path (extra disk, takes a while; the original backup is untouched).
en.bmgmt.delDataNote: Permanently delete this device's local backup to free space. Irreversible; the device itself is unaffected, and the next backup will be a full one.
en.bmgmt.offlineNote: Device offline — backup management is unavailable.
en.bmgmt.loadHint: Click “Refresh” above to load the backup file list. It's fetched from the device, so the larger the backup, the longer it takes (seconds for small ones, up to minutes for large backups).
en.bmgmt.noBackup: No backup yet for this device. Tap “Back up now” at the top to make the first one.
en.enc.unavailBody: The service has not loaded a valid master key and cannot safely store backup passwords. Check the startup logs and configuration directory permissions; existing encrypted data requires its original master key.
en.enc.unavailCmd: New instances generate and save a master key automatically. If you customize it with IOSBK_SECRET_KEY or IOSBK_SECRET_KEY_FILE, check the startup configuration without replacing the original key.
en.enc.explainIntro: Two different things show up here, with completely different jobs:
en.enc.k1What: The password you set for THIS iPad's backup — it encrypts the backup data itself.
en.enc.k1Like: Same as “Encrypt local backup” in iTunes / Finder.
en.enc.k1Lost: Lost = this device's encrypted backups can never be restored.
en.enc.k2What: The service uses it to securely store password ① so it can be retrieved later for change-password, turn-off-encryption, or restore.
en.enc.k2Like: It does NOT encrypt the iPad's backup.
en.enc.k2Scope: New instances generate and persist it automatically; back up the generated master key together with the configuration directory.
en.enc.k2Lost: Once used it must not change or be lost, or stored passwords become unreadable.
en.enc.vs: In short: ① locks the backup; ② just keeps ①'s key safe for you.
en.enc.warn: Once on, every future backup of this device is encrypted. Health, Keychain and Wi-Fi passwords are only in encrypted backups. A lost password means they can never be recovered.
en.enc.disableHint: Turning off requires the current password.
en.enc.offlineNote: The device must be online to change encryption.
en.enc.stateOffline: Device offline — can't read encryption state
en.danger.title: Restore (overwrites current device data)
en.danger.intro: Restoring overwrites the data currently on the device and cannot be undone. Read each note below first.
en.danger.findMy: Before restoring, turn off “Find My iPhone” on the device (Settings → Apple ID → Find My). Otherwise it will be blocked.
en.danger.reboot: After restoring the device reboots; unlock it once and it comes back over Wi-Fi on its own in ~1–2 minutes. Pairing stays valid.
en.danger.usb: For large backups, restore over USB — it's faster and more reliable.
en.danger.latch: “Allow restore” is a second safety latch, off by default.
en.danger.disabled: Restore is turned off. To restore, switch on “Allow restore” first.
en.restore.title: Confirm restore
en.restore.lead: This overwrites all data on the device with the backup — it cannot be undone.
en.restore.findMy: “Find My iPhone” is turned off on the device
en.restore.findMyHint: If it's on, restore is blocked (Error 211).
en.restore.understand: I understand this will overwrite / erase the data on the device
en.restore.typeName: Type the device name to confirm
en.restore.pwOptional: only for encrypted backups; leave blank otherwise
en.remove.title: Remove this device
en.remove.intro: Hide a device you no longer use and stop future tasks.
en.remove.stopBody: Manual and scheduled jobs will no longer start for this device.
en.remove.hideBody: It will not reappear automatically, even on the same network.
en.remove.keepBody: Existing backups, settings, and pairing information are not deleted.
en.remove.restoreHint: Restore it later from Settings → Removed devices; restoration does not start a backup.
en.remove.dialogTitle: Remove this device from the console?
en.remove.dialogSubtitle: This is reversible and does not delete any backup.
en.remove.dialogStop: Stop automatic and manual backups for this device
en.remove.dialogHide: Hide it from the active device list
en.remove.dialogKeep: Keep existing backups and settings on the NAS
en.remove.dialogPairing: Keep device data and pairing records unchanged
en.remove.dialogPairingBody: Restore it to the list later to continue with the existing settings.
en.remove.busy: The device is busy. Finish the current task before removing it.
en.remove.success: Device removed from the console; backups and settings are preserved.
en.removed.title: Removed devices
en.removed.menuHint: Restore devices previously hidden from the console
en.removed.subtitle: These devices are hidden and no longer run tasks. Their backups and settings are preserved.
en.removed.empty: No devices have been removed yet.
en.removed.loadFailed: Removed devices could not be loaded. Please try again.
en.removed.restoreSuccess: Device restored to the list. No backup was started.
en.removed.busy: The device state is changing. Please try again.
en.notif.title: Notifications
en.d.backingUpNote: Backup in progress — refresh and some buttons are greyed out until it finishes.
en.action.connectionServiceMessage.restorin: Restoring the {name} connection service. Please wait.
en.action.connectionServiceMessage.connecti: {name} connection service will recover after current device tasks finish.
{name} connection tools are unavailable. Check installation and permissions.
{name} connection service could not recover automatically. Check troubleshooting or retry manually.
{name} connection service recovery failed. Another attempt is scheduled.

en.action.renderConnectionHealth.noConnecte: No connected devices found. Connect a device to continue.
en.action.logoutSession.signOutFailedPlease: Sign out failed — please try again
en.action.pairingStatusText.tapTrustThisCom: Tap “Trust This Computer” and enter the device passcode.
en.action.trackPairingResult.cannotReadTheP: Cannot read the pairing result. Refresh the page to check.
en.action.trackPairingResult.theDeviceIsNoL: The device is no longer listed. Refresh the page to check.
en.action.trackPairingResult.pairingHasNotF: Pairing has not finished. Refresh later to check the result.
en.action.failed.pairingCheckStartedTheResu: Pairing check started. The result will appear below.
en.action.gateMsg.theConnectionServiceIsUna: The connection service is unavailable. Please wait for recovery.
en.action.fail.backupStartedYourDeviceWill: Backup started — your device will ask for its passcode; unlock it and enter promptly.
en.action.loadBackups.loadingDownloadingThe: Loading… (downloading the manifest from the device; larger backups take longer, please wait)
en.action.confirmDeleteBackup.thisPermanent:
This permanently deletes this device's local backup and cannot be undone.
Type the device name "{name}" to confirm:
en.action.doUnback.unpackingCreatesAFullBro: Unpacking creates a full browsable copy — extra disk and time. Continue?
en.action.setEncryption.onceEncryptionIsOnA: Once encryption is on, a lost password means backups can never be restored. Continue?
en.action.changeBackupPw.enterBothCurrentAn: Enter both current and new password
en.action.setRestoreEnabled.allowRestoreFor: Allow restore for this device? Restore is destructive.
en.action.setRestoreEnabled.turnOffRestoreF: Turn off restore for this device?
en.notif.subtitle: Get a message where you want it when backups succeed, fail, and more.
en.notif.masterBody: When off, none of the channels below will send.
en.notif.testBody: Send a test message to confirm everything's wired up.
en.notif.wecomDesc: Send via a WeCom group bot.
en.notif.webhookDesc: POST to your own HTTP endpoint.
en.notif.rulesBody: Choose which channels each event goes to.
en.notif.templatesBody: Customize the message body per event; blank uses the built-in default.
en.guide.brandSub: Back home on Wi-Fi — your iPhone and iPad back up automatically.
en.guide.heroTitle: Get this iPhone backing up at home
en.guide.heroLead: Complete one USB pairing the first time. The console guides each action and detects connection and backup states.
en.guide.stepSubs.1: Plug into the NAS or host
en.guide.rail: You only need to do this once. Reopen the guide from the menu whenever needed.
en.guide.s1Lead: Apple requires a Mac or Windows PC to enable wireless visibility first. Skip this if you only plan to use USB.
en.guide.s1Note: The NAS cannot verify this setting, so you confirm it manually. You can enable it later without blocking a USB backup today.
en.guide.wifiInstructions.mac.0: Connect the iPhone / iPad to the Mac with a cable.
en.guide.wifiInstructions.mac.1: Open Finder, select the device in the sidebar, then choose General.
en.guide.wifiInstructions.mac.2: Select “Show this device when on Wi-Fi”, then click Apply.
en.guide.wifiInstructions.windows.0: Install and open the Apple Devices app on Windows.
en.guide.wifiInstructions.windows.1: Connect the device by cable, select it in the sidebar, then choose General.
en.guide.wifiInstructions.windows.2: Select “Show this device when on Wi-Fi”, then click Apply.
en.guide.wifiInstructions.itunes.0: Connect the device by cable and select it in iTunes.
en.guide.wifiInstructions.itunes.2: Select “Sync with this device over Wi-Fi”, then click Apply.
en.guide.s2Title: Connect the device to the iOS Backup host
en.guide.s2Lead: Use a data-capable USB cable to plug the unlocked iPhone / iPad into the NAS or host running iOS Backup.
en.guide.usbWaitingDetail: Once connected, it is detected automatically; manual refresh is normally unnecessary.
en.guide.choose: Multiple USB devices were found. Choose the one to set up.
en.guide.s2Note: USB connection is detected by the backend in real time, so this step completes automatically.
en.guide.s3Lead: This trust belongs to the iOS Backup host. The device may ask again even if it already trusts another computer.
en.guide.pairWaitingDetail: Tap Trust on the iPhone / iPad and enter its device passcode if prompted.
en.guide.wrongBody: Not the console password or encrypted-backup password.
en.guide.s4Lead: Run one backup over USB to verify pairing, storage, and device communication before enabling automatic backups.
en.guide.auth: If the device asks for authorization, unlock it and enter its device passcode.
en.guide.backupSuccessBody: Device access, pairing, and local storage are verified. You can unplug the cable and enable automatic backups when ready.
en.guide.wifiAfterLead: When the device is found and your conditions are met, the system automatically attempts a backup. Confirm on the iPhone if iOS asks.
en.guide.conditions.1: Phone and NAS can reach each other
en.guide.conditions.3: Time and charging rules are met
en.guide.selectFirst: Connect and select a USB device first.
en.login.storyLead: Back up iPhone and iPad to your home NAS, with device and task status always in view.
en.login.title: Sign in
en.login.subtitle: Enter the administrator password to open the console.
en.login.insecure: LAN HTTP mode: password transport is not encrypted. Sign in only on a trusted network.
en.login.secure: This connection is protected with HTTPS.
en.common.operationFailed: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
en.notif.languageHint: Notification language is independent of the interface. Custom templates keep their original text.
en.guide.homeAria: Return to the iOS Backup home page
en.guide.wifiAlt: Connect the phone to a computer and enable Wi-Fi visibility
en.guide.usbAlt: Phone connected to the NAS using a USB cable
en.guide.trustAlt: Confirm trust and enter the device passcode on the phone
en.guide.backupAlt: Phone data backed up to the NAS over a cable
en.guide.autoAlt: Phone backed up to the NAS over home Wi-Fi
en.guide.invalidStatus: Device status could not be read. Please try again shortly.
en.guide.pairingFailed: Pairing could not be verified. Please retry or check the logs.
en.guide.connectionProblem.restarting: Restoring the USB connection service. Please wait.
en.guide.connectionProblem.waitingBusy: Waiting for current device tasks to finish before recovering the connection service.
en.guide.connectionProblem.manualRequired: USB connection recovery failed. Return to the console to check its status.
en.guide.connectionProblem.backoff: USB connection recovery failed. Another attempt is scheduled.
en.guide.connectionProblem.unavailable: USB connection service is unavailable. Device status is temporarily unknown.
en.notif.testNoTargets: No enabled channel matches this event. Check the rules and save your settings.
en.notif.testFailed: The test could not be delivered. Check the channel settings and server logs, then retry.
en.notif.testPartial: Test delivered to {succeeded} channel(s); {failed} failed. Check the failed channels.
en.bindex.offlineNote: The device is offline. Backups saved locally are still available to view.
en.bindex.sizeNote: Original backup only; excludes unpacked copies and temporary files.
en.bindex.latestNote: Most recent success recorded by this app.
en.bindex.filesNote: Browse paths in this backup. File contents are not included.
en.bindex.previewNote: Search covers the loaded preview only. Download CSV for the complete list.
en.bindex.previousRead: Some information comes from a previous read and has not been rechecked.
en.bindex.fullCSV: Download the complete saved file list.
en.bindex.noCSV: No complete file list is available to download.
en.bindex.noMatches: No matches in this preview. Files may still exist elsewhere in the full backup.
en.bindex.emptyManifest: The completed file list contains no entries.
en.bindex.readingList: Reading the local file list. Search and CSV download become available when reading finishes.
en.bindex.encryptedList: Encrypted file listing is not supported yet. There is no saved file list to preview or download.
en.bindex.noList: The file list is unavailable. This does not mean the backup contains no files.
en.bindex.trustNote: A readable file list does not verify that a backup can be restored.
en.bindex.offlineReadyBody: The overview and file list were read from the local backup.
en.bindex.firstBody: The first read may take a moment. Information appears automatically; no device connection is needed.
en.bindex.firstFailedTitle: Local backup information could not be read
en.bindex.firstFailedBody: No previous information is available. Check the backup location and access permissions, then retry.
en.bindex.refreshingBody: Showing the previous information until the update finishes.
en.bindex.failedTitle: Update failed. Previous information is retained
en.bindex.failedBody: Available information is retained and may be out of date. This read failure does not change the backup result.
en.bindex.encryptedBody: Reading an encrypted file list is not supported yet. Basic information remains available.
en.bindex.encryptedCachedTitle: Showing a previously saved file list
en.bindex.encryptedCachedBody: The encrypted file list cannot be read again. This saved list has not been rechecked.
en.bindex.unavailableBody: Previously read information is retained when available. Check the storage mount and access permissions, then retry.
en.bindex.emptyTitle: No local backup for this device yet
en.bindex.emptyBody: The overview and file list will appear after the first backup.
en.control.stopRisk: Stopping will interrupt this backup and may affect the recoverability of the previous backup. Automatic backups will be on hold until you explicitly resume them.
en.control.stopDetail: Backup files will not be deliberately deleted. A later backup starts a new task; continuing from this exact progress is not guaranteed.
en.control.stoppingHint: Waiting for the backup process to exit. Automatic backups are on hold.
en.control.stoppedHint: The existing backup has not been verified as recoverable. You can start another backup when ready.
en.control.holdHint: This setting remains after a restart. Back up once manually, or resume the automatic schedule separately.
en.control.resumeHint: Resuming keeps your original schedule and conditions. If due, a backup may start at the next check.
en.control.holdSaveFailed: Backups are on hold in this session, but the setting was not reliably saved. Retry saving; the state after a restart is not guaranteed.
en.control.holdSaving: Automatic backups are on hold. Saving this setting…
en.control.resumed: Automatic backup hold cleared. Your original schedule still applies.
en.control.unknownResult: The request result is unknown. Refreshing the current backup status…
en.control.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the status. Reconnect or refresh the page before retrying.
en.jobs.held: Automatic backups are on hold until you resume them. Your schedule is unchanged.
en.jobs.holdSaving: Automatic backups are on hold. Saving this state…
en.jobs.stoppedHint: The administrator stopped this task. The current backup may be incomplete.
en.jobs.advanced: Advanced options for the next manual backup
en.jobs.title: Task records
en.jobs.truncated: This log is incomplete; {count} events were dropped or expired.
en.jobs.copyFailed: Could not copy. Use Download logs instead.
en.jobs.stoppingHint: Waiting for the backup process to exit and release this device.
en.jobs.fullHint: Automatic selection lets the device and tool choose a compatible mode. Force full requests a complete backup; it does not create a historical restore point. This choice resets after starting.
en.jobs.recordsUnavailable: Some task records are unavailable. Backup execution can continue.
en.jobs.stopConfirm: Stop this backup? Automatic backups will be held until you resume them. The current backup may be incomplete and may not be restorable.
en.jobs.holdSaveError: Automatic backups are held in this process, but saving failed. Retry before restarting.
en.jobs.viewLimit: Shows up to 1,000 recent events. Copy or download all retained events.
en.jobs.retention: Records describe task execution; they are not historical backup copies. Retained for up to 30 days, subject to count and storage limits.
en.jobs.saveError: The record has not been fully saved. Details may be lost after restart.
en.check.title: Backup check
en.check.scope: Automatic quick checks cover required metadata and completion status. Manual checks also verify that regular file objects in an unencrypted manifest exist; they do not verify all content hashes or guarantee a successful device restore. Large scans use disk resources and are limited to 15 minutes.
en.check.coverage: Metadata complete: {metadata}; manifest scan complete: {manifest}; records read: {records}, objects found: {objects}, missing objects: {missing}
en.check.freshness.stale: This backup has changed since the check; this result is stale.
en.check.freshness.unknown: This is a historical check result; its current validity has not been re-established.
en.check.reason.metadata_missing: Required metadata or manifest is missing
en.check.reason.metadata_invalid: Required metadata or manifest is invalid
en.check.reason.unsafe_source: Source contains unsupported paths or objects
en.check.reason.encrypted_manifest: Encrypted manifest cannot currently be read
en.check.reason.missing_objects: File objects referenced by the manifest are missing
en.check.reason.process_restarted: Application restarted before the check finished
en.history.title: Historical restore points
en.history.enable: Keep historical restore points for this device
en.history.cost: Each backup uses an independent working copy. If fast cloning is unavailable, a 100 GB backup may use about 300 GB for three points, plus working space.
en.history.retention: Keep the last normal point of each day, including today. Pins, the latest baseline, older encryption versions and manually retained points can exceed this count.
en.history.disableHint: Turning history off stops new points and automatic cleanup. Existing points remain until you delete them. Re-enabling only manages newly created points.
en.history.summaryOff: History is off · {count} saved points remain
en.history.storage: Saved data: {size} (logical size; shared blocks may use less disk)
en.history.unavailable: Some history storage is unavailable. Reconnect it to view all points; missing storage is not treated as empty.
en.history.busy: A device task is running. Changes and checks are temporarily unavailable.
en.history.transition: History settings are still being applied. Check storage access before retrying.
en.history.manualHint: History is off. Saved points still use disk space and require manual deletion.
en.history.empty: No restore points yet. A successful backup will create the first point.
en.history.off: History is off by default. Enable it in Backup settings to start keeping versions.
en.history.unknownDateHint: The original completion time could not be established. This imported data remains a pending, manually retained result.
en.history.restoreHint: Export the complete backup, extract it on your computer, then restore with Finder or Apple Devices. A passed check does not confirm a successful device restore. Restoring replaces newer data on the phone.
en.history.passwordHint: This point is encrypted. Keep the password used at that time; the current password may be different.
en.history.reviewSaveFailed: The check finished, but its evidence could not be saved. Retry after checking storage access.
en.history.enableConfirm: Save this policy for the device? Independent copies require extra space; eligible old points are cleaned during subsequent backups.
en.history.previewCount: {count} points become eligible for automatic cleanup. Pinned and protected points stay.
en.history.deleteConfirm: This permanently removes only the selected backup data. Other points remain unchanged.
en.history.deletePin: This point is pinned. Deletion overrides that protection.
en.history.deleteBaseline: This is a normal baseline. Deleting the last compatible baseline requires a full backup next time.
en.history.export.ready: Ready. Start the download within five minutes.
en.history.export.transferred: Server transfer ended. Confirm the downloaded file on your computer.
en.history.export.failed: Transfer failed. Discard the partial file and start a new export.
en.history.export.cancelled: Export cancelled. Any partial file is not a complete backup.
en.history.export.expired: Export session expired or server restarted. Start a new export.
en.term.pinned.title: Pinned
en.term.pinned.hint: Excluded from automatic cleanup until you unpin it. It still uses storage; you can explicitly delete it.
en.term.baseline.title: Latest normal baseline
en.term.baseline.hint: A complete normal backup used to prepare a compatible next backup. It stays even beyond the retention window.
en.term.quick.title: Quick check
en.term.quick.hint: Checks completion state and required metadata, without reading every data object or proving a successful phone restore.
en.term.clone.title: Fast clone
en.term.clone.hint: When the storage supports it and passes a probe, unchanged data blocks can be shared safely. Otherwise independent full copies are used.
en.term.pending.title: Pending result
en.term.pending.hint: The backup tool finished, but checking found issues or could not finish. It is saved separately and does not become an incremental baseline. Rechecking only updates evidence.
en.term.manual.title: Manually retained
en.term.manual.hint: Preserved when history was disabled or imported with uncertain time. It remains until you explicitly delete it, including after re-enabling history.
en.console.settingsHint: Edit and save each group separately. Cancel discards unsaved changes in that group.
en.console.currentDetails: Current backup details and file list
en.console.mutableHint: Regular backups update this data. It is not an independently retained history point.
en.console.noCurrent: No current backup was found. Retained history points can still be opened individually.
en.console.sourceUnavailable: The current backup is unavailable. Check its location and storage connection.
en.console.openGeneratingJob: View the job that created this backup
en.console.browseCurrent: Browse the current backup file list
en.console.noLinkedBackup: No linked backup is recorded. Job records and backup data have separate retention rules.
en.console.pointMissing: The related backup is missing or unavailable; its job record may remain.
en.console.jobMissing: This job record has expired or been removed. The backup data is unaffected.
en.console.savedWithIssue: The backup was saved; an issue occurred during {phase}. Review the related backup and log.
en.console.scheduleHint: The window uses the deployment time zone. The interval measures elapsed time.
en.console.pathHint: Changing the location does not move existing backups. Only deployment-approved paths are allowed.
en.console.copy.unknown: Copy method: depends on the storage. No reliable capability result is available yet.
en.console.copy.clone: Copy method: copy-on-write cloning is supported.
en.console.storageHint: Combined size is logical size, not actual disk usage. A new backup also needs working space. Insufficient capacity stops the new backup while protecting retained history.
en.console.storageUnavailable: Free space is temporarily unavailable; this does not mean the disk is full.
en.console.backupHint: Make sure the phone is online. It may ask you to unlock it or enter its passcode to authorize backup.
en.console.deploymentHint: Backup windows, displayed times, notifications and application logs use the deployment time zone. Changing language does not change the schedule; the server TZ setting controls the time zone.
en.console.recentIssue: The latest backup needs attention: {state} Retained backups are listed below.
en.console.unpinHint: After unpinning, the applicable retention rules may automatically remove this backup.
en.notif.testUsesSaved: Test messages use the saved notification settings.
en.notif.saveBeforeTest: Save your changes before sending a test message.
en.notif.loadFailed: Could not load saved settings. Reload them before saving or testing.
en.notif.confirmFailed: Could not confirm the saved settings. Your draft is kept; save again before testing.

zh-CN.app.title: iOS Backup
zh-CN.app.subtitle: 回到家连上 Wi-Fi，就自动备份你的 iPhone 和 iPad。
zh-CN.header.autoBusy: 实时更新 · {n} 台设备有任务运行中
zh-CN.header.restartHint: 没找到设备时点这里：重启底层的 USB 与 Wi-Fi 连接服务，不影响你的备份文件。
zh-CN.empty.title: 还没有连接任何设备
zh-CN.empty.subtitle: 三步即可完成第一次备份，全程不需要懂任何专业名词。
zh-CN.empty.s1b: 用数据线把 iPhone / iPad 插到本机，或让它和本机连同一个 Wi-Fi。
zh-CN.empty.s2b: 设备会弹出「要信任此电脑吗？」，点「信任」并输入锁屏密码。
zh-CN.empty.s3b: 设备会出现在下面，点一下就开始备份；之后可设为自动。
zh-CN.progress.waitingAuthorizationHint: 请查看 iPhone，并按提示输入锁屏密码。超过等待期限后本次备份会停止。
zh-CN.progress.waitingDeviceHint: 正在等待手机的下一步响应。较大的加密备份在准备阶段可能需要几分钟，总体进度暂时不变。
zh-CN.progress.sendingHint: 正在发送备份所需的数据；增量备份会先发送已有清单。
zh-CN.progress.stalledHint: 长时间未检测到备份活动，本次任务已停止。请检查手机授权和网络后重新备份。
zh-CN.progress.preparingSubtitle: 正在取得可计算的总体进度
zh-CN.progress.preparingHint: 请在 iPhone 上留意授权提示，并保持设备可解锁。
zh-CN.progress.runningHint: 正在接收备份数据，请保持设备连接稳定。
zh-CN.progress.overallOnlyHint: 当前没有可靠的文件字节信息，页面只展示总体进度。
zh-CN.progress.currentFileHint: 当前正在传输的文件进度
zh-CN.progress.reconnectingHint: Wi-Fi 连接暂时中断，正在保留最后进度并等待设备重新上线。
zh-CN.progress.interruptedHint: 设备持续离线，本次备份已安全停止。重新连接后可再次开始备份。
zh-CN.progress.failedHint: 请保持设备在线并重新尝试。
zh-CN.progress.storageHint: 请检查保存位置的剩余空间和写入权限。
zh-CN.progress.lockedHint: 请解锁设备，并按提示输入设备锁屏密码。
zh-CN.gate.busy: 设备正忙（已有备份或操作进行中）
zh-CN.gate.notCharging: 该设备开了「仅充电时备份」，请充电后再试
zh-CN.gate.lowBattery: 电量 {b}% 低于设定的最低 {m}%，已跳过
zh-CN.gate.backupBusy: 已有其他设备在备份，请稍后再试
zh-CN.menu.title: 菜单
zh-CN.menu.onboardingHint: 连接、信任并完成第一次备份
zh-CN.menu.notifHint: 配置备份成功/失败等事件的通知
zh-CN.menu.refreshHint: 立即重扫 USB / Wi-Fi 设备
zh-CN.update.banner: 已部署新版本，点此刷新页面
zh-CN.migration.text: 这台设备以前是用 Wi-Fi 备份的，现在离线了。如果它换了网络（本机自动发现不到），在「备份设置」里填上它的 IP 就能继续无线备份。
zh-CN.bset.windowHint: 只在这个时间段内自动备份（例如夜里）。
zh-CN.bset.minBatteryHint: 电量低于这个值就不自动备份，避免耗光电。
zh-CN.bset.autoBackupHint: 关闭后只能手动点「立即备份」。
zh-CN.bset.dirHint: 备份文件存放的文件夹。
zh-CN.bset.ipPlaceholder: 留空即可 — 同一 Wi-Fi 会自动找到
zh-CN.bset.ipHint: 同一个 Wi-Fi 下会自动发现，留空就好。只有跨网段或用 Tailscale 时才需要手动填。
zh-CN.bset.passcodeNote: 由于 iOS 安全机制，每次备份开始时都需要在设备上输入锁屏密码。请在备份时段保持手机可解锁、留意提示并及时输入，超过等待期限后本次备份会停止。
zh-CN.bset.testOk: 设备已连接，保存设置可保留此 IP
zh-CN.bset.dirOk: 保存位置可用，保存设置后生效
zh-CN.bset.dirBad: 保存位置不可用，请重新填写
zh-CN.bset.offlineHelp: 设备显示离线？① 确认它亮屏、和本机在同一个 Wi-Fi；② 在设备上断开重连 Wi-Fi（或到「设置 → Wi-Fi → ⓘ → 私有 Wi-Fi 地址」切换一下）来刷新连接；③ 知道 IP 就填到上面点「测试连接」。
zh-CN.bset.pairHint: 第一次连接需要在设备上点「信任此电脑」。
zh-CN.bmgmt.filesNote: 仅本机 / 内网可见，请勿外传。
zh-CN.bmgmt.deleteNote: 备份里的文件是哈希命名的，没法直接翻看。解包会按原始路径还原成一份可浏览的文件夹副本（额外占磁盘、较耗时；不会改动原备份）。
zh-CN.bmgmt.delDataNote: 把这台设备在本机的备份整份删除以释放空间。不可恢复；不影响设备本身，下次会重新做一次完整备份。
zh-CN.bmgmt.offlineNote: 设备离线，备份管理暂不可用。
zh-CN.bmgmt.loadHint: 点上方「刷新」加载备份文件清单。清单要从设备下载，备份文件越大、加载越久（小则几秒，大备份可能要十几秒到几分钟）。
zh-CN.bmgmt.noBackup: 这台设备还没有备份。点右上角「立即备份」做第一次备份吧。
zh-CN.enc.unavailBody: 服务未加载有效的主密钥，无法安全保存备份密码。请检查启动日志和配置目录权限；已有加密数据必须使用原主密钥。
zh-CN.enc.unavailCmd: 新实例默认自动生成并保存主密钥；如使用 IOSBK_SECRET_KEY 或 IOSBK_SECRET_KEY_FILE 自定义，请核对启动配置，不要直接替换原密钥。
zh-CN.enc.explainIntro: 界面里出现两样东西，作用完全不同：
zh-CN.enc.k1What: 你给这台 iPad 的备份设的密码，加密的是备份数据本身。
zh-CN.enc.k1Like: 等同 iTunes / 访达里的「加密本地备份」。
zh-CN.enc.k1Lost: 丢了 = 这台设备的加密备份永久无法恢复。
zh-CN.enc.k2What: 服务用它把上面①的密码加密后安全存档，方便日后改密 / 关加密 / 恢复时取用。
zh-CN.enc.k2Like: 它不加密 iPad 的备份。
zh-CN.enc.k2Scope: 新实例默认自动生成并持久保存；自动生成的主密钥需与配置目录一起备份。
zh-CN.enc.k2Lost: 一旦用过就不能更换或丢失，否则已存的密码再也读不出。
zh-CN.enc.vs: 简单说：① 锁的是备份；② 只是帮你把①的钥匙安全收好。
zh-CN.enc.warn: 开启后，这台设备之后每次备份都会加密。健康、钥匙串、Wi-Fi 密码等只在加密备份里。密码丢失 = 永久无法恢复。
zh-CN.enc.disableHint: 关闭需要输入当前密码。
zh-CN.enc.offlineNote: 加密操作需要设备在线。
zh-CN.enc.stateOffline: 设备离线，无法读取加密状态
zh-CN.danger.title: 备份恢复（会覆盖设备现有数据）
zh-CN.danger.intro: 恢复会用备份覆盖设备上的现有数据，不可逆。请逐条确认下面的提示。
zh-CN.danger.findMy: 恢复前，先在设备上关闭「查找我的 iPhone」（设置 → Apple ID → 查找）。否则会被系统拦下。
zh-CN.danger.reboot: 恢复后设备会重启；解锁一次后，约 1–2 分钟会自动经 Wi-Fi 重新上线，配对仍有效。
zh-CN.danger.usb: 备份较大时，建议插 USB 恢复，更快也更稳。
zh-CN.danger.latch: 「允许恢复」是第二道保险，默认关闭。
zh-CN.danger.disabled: 恢复功能已关闭。确需恢复时，请先打开「允许恢复」。
zh-CN.restore.title: 确认恢复
zh-CN.restore.lead: 将用备份覆盖此设备的全部数据 —— 此操作不可逆。
zh-CN.restore.findMy: 已在设备上关闭「查找我的 iPhone」
zh-CN.restore.understand: 我已理解：这会覆盖 / 清除设备上的现有数据
zh-CN.restore.pwOptional: 加密备份才需要，可留空
zh-CN.remove.title: 移除这台设备
zh-CN.remove.intro: 不再使用这台设备时，可将它从控制台隐藏并停止后续任务。
zh-CN.remove.stopBody: 手动和定时任务都不会再为这台设备启动。
zh-CN.remove.hideBody: 即使仍在同一网络，也不会自动重新出现。
zh-CN.remove.keepBody: 不会删除已有备份、配置和配对信息。
zh-CN.remove.restoreHint: 之后可在“设置 → 已移除设备”中恢复，不会自动开始备份。
zh-CN.remove.dialogSubtitle: 这是可恢复操作，不会删除任何备份。
zh-CN.remove.dialogStop: 停止这台设备的自动与手动备份
zh-CN.remove.dialogKeep: 保留 NAS 上的已有备份与设置
zh-CN.remove.dialogPairing: 不影响设备数据和配对记录
zh-CN.remove.dialogPairingBody: 以后恢复到列表即可继续使用原有设置。
zh-CN.remove.busy: 设备正在执行任务，请完成后再移除
zh-CN.remove.success: 设备已从控制台移除，备份和设置均已保留
zh-CN.removed.title: 已移除设备
zh-CN.removed.menuHint: 恢复以前从控制台隐藏的设备
zh-CN.removed.subtitle: 这些设备已停止任务并从首页隐藏，已有备份和设置仍然保留。
zh-CN.removed.loadFailed: 无法加载已移除设备，请稍后重试。
zh-CN.removed.restoreSuccess: 设备已恢复到列表，不会自动开始备份
zh-CN.removed.busy: 设备状态正在变化，请稍后重试。
zh-CN.notif.title: 通知设置
zh-CN.d.backingUpNote: 备份进行中，期间刷新与部分按钮会变灰，结束后自动恢复。
zh-CN.status.unknown: 设备状态暂时无法确认

zh-CN.action.pairingStatusText.tapTrustThisCom: 请在设备上点击“信任此电脑”并输入锁屏密码。
zh-CN.action.trackPairingResult.cannotReadTheP: 无法读取配对结果，请刷新页面查看。
zh-CN.action.trackPairingResult.theDeviceIsNoL: 设备已不在列表中，请刷新页面查看。
zh-CN.action.trackPairingResult.pairingHasNotF: 配对检查尚未完成，请稍后刷新查看结果。
zh-CN.action.failed.pairingCheckStartedTheResu: 配对检查已开始，结果会显示在下方。

zh-CN.action.fail.backupStartedYourDeviceWill: 已开始备份。设备上会要求输入锁屏密码，请解锁手机并及时输入。
zh-CN.action.loadBackups.loadingDownloadingThe: 加载中…（要从设备下载清单，备份越大越久，请耐心等待）

zh-CN.action.doUnback.unpackingCreatesAFullBro: 解包会生成一份完整副本，占用额外磁盘空间且耗时较长。确定继续？
zh-CN.action.doUnback.unpackStartedSeeLogs: 解包已开始，请查看日志
zh-CN.action.setEncryption.onceEncryptionIsOnA: 开启加密后，密码丢失将导致备份永久无法恢复。确定开启？
zh-CN.action.changeBackupPw.enterBothCurrentAn: 请输入当前密码和新密码
zh-CN.action.setRestoreEnabled.allowRestoreFor: 确定开启该设备的「允许恢复」？恢复是破坏性操作。
zh-CN.action.setRestoreEnabled.turnOffRestoreF: 关闭该设备的恢复功能？
zh-CN.notif.subtitle: 备份成功、失败等事件发生时，把消息发到你常用的地方。
zh-CN.notif.masterBody: 关闭后，下面所有渠道都不会发送。
zh-CN.notif.testBody: 发一条测试消息，确认配置无误。
zh-CN.notif.testSent: 测试通知已发送，请到对应渠道查看。
zh-CN.notif.tgDesc: 通过 Telegram 机器人发送。
zh-CN.notif.emailDesc: 通过 SMTP 发送邮件。
zh-CN.notif.wecomDesc: 通过企业微信群机器人发送。
zh-CN.notif.barkDesc: 通过 Bark 推送到 iPhone。
zh-CN.notif.webhookDesc: 发送到你自定义的 HTTP 地址。
zh-CN.notif.rulesBody: 选择每种事件要发到哪些渠道。
zh-CN.notif.templatesBody: 按事件自定义通知正文；留空时使用内建默认模板。
zh-CN.guide.brandSub: 回到家连上 Wi-Fi，就自动备份你的 iPhone 和 iPad。
zh-CN.guide.offline: 实时状态已断开，正在重连
zh-CN.guide.heroTitle: 让这台 iPhone 开始在家自动备份
zh-CN.guide.heroLead: 第一次只需完成一次 USB 配对。系统会告诉你下一步做什么，并自动识别连接和备份状态。
zh-CN.guide.stepSubs.0: 可选，只用 USB 可跳过
zh-CN.guide.stepSubs.1: 把设备插到 NAS / 主机
zh-CN.guide.rail: 这套设置只需做一次。完成后仍可从菜单重新打开向导。
zh-CN.guide.s1Title: 准备以后通过 Wi-Fi 备份
zh-CN.guide.s1Lead: Apple 要求先通过 Mac 或 Windows 打开无线连接。只准备使用 USB 备份，可以直接跳过。
zh-CN.guide.s1Note: 这一项无法由 NAS 自动判断，需要你确认。以后想开也可以；不会影响今天先用 USB 备份。
zh-CN.guide.wifiInstructions.mac.0: 用数据线把 iPhone / iPad 接到 Mac。
zh-CN.guide.wifiInstructions.mac.1: 打开 Finder，在侧边栏选择设备，然后进入“通用”。
zh-CN.guide.wifiInstructions.mac.2: 勾选“连接 Wi-Fi 时显示此 iPhone / iPad”，点击“应用”。
zh-CN.guide.wifiInstructions.windows.0: 在 Windows 安装并打开 Apple Devices（Apple 设备）App。
zh-CN.guide.wifiInstructions.windows.1: 用数据线连接设备，在侧边栏选择它，然后进入“通用”。
zh-CN.guide.wifiInstructions.windows.2: 勾选“连接 Wi-Fi 时显示此 iPhone / iPad”，点击“应用”。
zh-CN.guide.wifiInstructions.itunes.0: 用数据线连接设备，在 iTunes 中选择它。
zh-CN.guide.wifiInstructions.itunes.2: 勾选“通过 Wi-Fi 与此设备同步”，点击“应用”。
zh-CN.guide.s2Title: 把设备连接到 iOS Backup 主机
zh-CN.guide.s2Lead: 请使用支持数据传输的 USB 线，把已经解锁的 iPhone / iPad 插到运行 iOS Backup 的 NAS 或主机。
zh-CN.guide.usbWaitingDetail: 插好后，系统会自动识别；通常不需要手动刷新。
zh-CN.guide.usbFound: 已检测到 USB 设备
zh-CN.guide.choose: 检测到多台 USB 设备，请选择要设置的一台。
zh-CN.guide.s2Note: USB 连接状态由后端实时识别；检测到设备后，这一步会自动完成。
zh-CN.guide.s3Title: 在 iPhone 上确认“信任”
zh-CN.guide.s3Lead: 这是与 iOS Backup 主机建立的独立信任关系。即使手机以前信任过 Mac 或 Windows，这里仍可能再询问一次。
zh-CN.guide.pairWaitingDetail: 在 iPhone / iPad 上点“信任”，并按提示输入设备锁屏密码。
zh-CN.guide.correctBody: iPhone / iPad 的设备锁屏密码。
zh-CN.guide.wrongBody: 不是控制台登录密码，也不是加密本地备份密码。
zh-CN.guide.s4Lead: 先用 USB 完成一次备份，确认配对、存储路径和设备通信都正常；之后再开启自动备份。
zh-CN.guide.auth: 如设备出现授权提示，请解锁并输入设备锁屏密码。
zh-CN.guide.finish: 查看 Wi-Fi 自动备份
zh-CN.guide.backupSuccessBody: 设备、配对和本地存储均已验证。现在可以拔掉数据线，并按需要开启自动备份。
zh-CN.guide.wifiAfterTitle: 以后通过 Wi-Fi 备份
zh-CN.guide.wifiAfterLead: 系统发现设备并满足你设置的条件后，会自动尝试发起备份；如 iOS 要求授权，请在手机上完成确认。
zh-CN.guide.conditions.1: 手机与 NAS 网络可互通
zh-CN.guide.selectFirst: 请先连接并选择一台 USB 设备。
zh-CN.login.storyLead: 将 iPhone 和 iPad 自动备份到家里的 NAS，随时查看设备与任务状态。
zh-CN.login.title: 身份验证
zh-CN.login.subtitle: 输入管理员密码以打开控制台。
zh-CN.login.insecure: 局域网 HTTP 模式：密码传输未加密。请仅在可信网络中登录。
zh-CN.page.onboarding: 首次使用向导 · iOS Backup
zh-CN.notif.languageHint: 通知语言独立于界面语言；自定义模板保留原文。
zh-CN.guide.homeAria: 返回 iOS Backup 首页
zh-CN.guide.wifiAlt: 手机连接电脑并开启 Wi-Fi 显示
zh-CN.guide.usbAlt: 手机通过 USB 数据线连接 NAS
zh-CN.guide.trustAlt: 在手机上确认信任并输入设备锁屏密码
zh-CN.guide.backupAlt: 手机数据通过数据线备份到 NAS
zh-CN.guide.autoAlt: 手机通过家庭 Wi-Fi 自动备份到 NAS
zh-CN.guide.invalidStatus: 暂时无法读取设备状态，请稍候重试。
zh-CN.guide.pairingFailed: 配对检查未完成，请稍后重试。
zh-CN.guide.connectionProblem.restarting: 正在恢复 USB 连接服务，请稍候。
zh-CN.guide.connectionProblem.waitingBusy: 连接服务异常，等待当前设备任务结束后恢复。
zh-CN.guide.connectionProblem.manualRequired: USB 连接服务自动恢复失败，请返回控制台查看状态。
zh-CN.guide.connectionProblem.backoff: USB 连接服务恢复失败，稍后自动重试。

zh-CN.guide.connectionProblem.unavailable: USB 连接服务异常，设备状态暂时无法确认。
zh-CN.notif.testNoTargets: 此事件没有匹配的已启用渠道，请检查规则并保存设置。
zh-CN.notif.testFailed: 测试通知发送失败，请检查渠道设置和服务日志后重试。
zh-CN.notif.testPartial: 测试通知已送达 {succeeded} 个渠道，{failed} 个失败，请检查失败渠道。
zh-CN.bindex.offlineNote: 设备已离线，仍可查看保存在本地的备份信息。
zh-CN.bindex.sizeNote: 仅统计原始备份，不含解包副本和临时文件。
zh-CN.bindex.countNote: 包含文件、文件夹和链接。
zh-CN.bindex.latestNote: 由本应用记录的最近成功时间。
zh-CN.bindex.filesNote: 查看备份中的文件路径，不包含文件内容。
zh-CN.bindex.previewNote: 搜索仅覆盖已加载预览，完整清单请下载 CSV。
zh-CN.bindex.previousRead: 部分信息来自上次读取，尚未重新核对。
zh-CN.bindex.fullCSV: 下载已保存的完整清单。
zh-CN.bindex.noCSV: 暂无可供下载的完整清单。
zh-CN.bindex.noMatches: 当前预览中没有匹配项，完整备份中仍可能包含该文件。
zh-CN.bindex.emptyManifest: 已读取的完整清单不包含任何条目。
zh-CN.bindex.readingList: 正在读取本地清单，完成后即可搜索和下载 CSV。
zh-CN.bindex.encryptedList: 暂不支持读取加密清单，且没有已保存的清单可供预览或下载。
zh-CN.bindex.noList: 暂时无法读取清单，这并不表示备份中没有文件。
zh-CN.bindex.range: 当前预览第 {start}–{end} 条，共 {n} 条
zh-CN.bindex.trustNote: 清单可读不代表已通过恢复验证。
zh-CN.bindex.offlineReadyBody: 概况和文件清单来自本地备份。
zh-CN.bindex.firstTitle: 正在读取本地备份信息
zh-CN.bindex.firstBody: 首次读取可能需要一些时间，完成后会自动显示，无需连接设备。
zh-CN.bindex.firstFailedTitle: 无法读取本地备份信息
zh-CN.bindex.firstFailedBody: 没有可用的历史信息，请检查备份位置和访问权限后重试。
zh-CN.bindex.refreshingTitle: 正在更新本地备份信息
zh-CN.bindex.refreshingBody: 更新完成前，继续显示上次读取的信息。
zh-CN.bindex.failedTitle: 更新失败，已保留上次信息
zh-CN.bindex.failedBody: 仍显示已读取的信息，内容可能已过期。此次读取失败不会改变备份结果。
zh-CN.bindex.encryptedBody: 暂不支持读取加密文件清单，仍可查看基本信息。
zh-CN.bindex.encryptedCachedTitle: 正在显示此前保存的清单
zh-CN.bindex.encryptedCachedBody: 当前无法重新读取加密清单，已保存的清单尚未重新核对。
zh-CN.bindex.unavailableBody: 如有已读取的信息则继续保留，请检查存储挂载和访问权限后重试。
zh-CN.bindex.emptyBody: 完成首次备份后，将显示概况和文件清单。
zh-CN.control.stopRisk: 停止会中断本次备份，并可能影响上一份备份的可恢复性。自动备份将暂缓，直到你主动恢复。
zh-CN.control.stopDetail: 不会主动删除备份文件。稍后备份将发起新任务，不保证从当前进度继续。
zh-CN.control.stoppingHint: 正在等待备份进程退出，自动备份已暂缓。
zh-CN.control.stopped: 已停止 · 本次备份未完成
zh-CN.control.stoppedHint: 现有备份的可恢复性尚未验证。准备好后，可重新发起备份。
zh-CN.control.holdHint: 重启后仍保持暂缓。你可以手动备份一次，或另行恢复自动计划。
zh-CN.control.resumeHint: 恢复后仍遵守原计划条件；如果已经到期，下一轮检查就可能开始。
zh-CN.control.holdSaveFailed: 当前进程已暂缓自动备份，但设置未能可靠保存。请重试保存，重启后的状态尚无保证。
zh-CN.control.holdSaving: 自动备份已暂缓，正在保存设置…
zh-CN.control.resumed: 已解除自动备份暂缓，继续遵守原计划设置。
zh-CN.control.holdSaved: 自动备份暂缓状态已保存。
zh-CN.control.unknownResult: 尚无法确认请求结果，正在刷新备份状态…
zh-CN.control.refreshFailed: 状态刷新失败，请恢复连接或刷新页面后再操作。
zh-CN.jobs.held: 自动备份已暂缓，直到你手动恢复；原计划设置保持不变。
zh-CN.jobs.holdSaving: 自动备份已暂缓，正在保存状态…
zh-CN.jobs.stoppedHint: 管理员已停止此任务，当前备份可能不完整。
zh-CN.jobs.advanced: 下次手动备份的高级选项
zh-CN.jobs.title: 任务记录
zh-CN.jobs.truncated: 此日志不完整；有 {count} 条事件被丢弃或清理。
zh-CN.jobs.modeSummary: 请求方式：{requested} · 实际类型：{observed}
zh-CN.jobs.copyFailed: 复制失败，请使用下载日志。
zh-CN.jobs.stoppingHint: 正在等待备份进程退出并释放设备。
zh-CN.jobs.fullHint: 自动选择由设备和工具按兼容基线处理；强制全量请求重新备份全部内容，不会因此新增历史恢复点。发起后此选项恢复默认。
zh-CN.jobs.recordsUnavailable: 部分任务记录不可用，备份执行仍可继续。
zh-CN.jobs.stopConfirm: 停止本次备份？自动备份将暂缓，直到手动恢复。当前备份可能不完整，无法保证可恢复。
zh-CN.jobs.holdSaveError: 自动备份已在当前进程暂缓，但状态保存异常。重启前请重试保存。
zh-CN.jobs.viewLimit: 页面显示最近最多 1,000 条事件；复制或下载可获取全部已保留事件。
zh-CN.jobs.retention: 记录只说明任务执行情况，不代表保存了历史备份副本。最多保留 30 天，同时受数量和空间上限限制。
zh-CN.jobs.empty: 暂无已保留的任务记录。
zh-CN.jobs.saveError: 记录未完整保存，重启后可能缺少详情。
zh-CN.check.title: 备份检查
zh-CN.check.scope: 自动轻量检查只检查必要元数据和完成状态。手动检查另核对未加密清单中的普通文件对象是否存在；不检查全部内容哈希，不保证真机恢复成功。大备份检查期间会占用磁盘，最长 15 分钟。
zh-CN.check.coverage: 元数据完整：{metadata}；清单扫描完整：{manifest}；已读条目 {records}，已确认对象 {objects}，缺失对象 {missing}
zh-CN.check.state.unavailable: 检查未完成或无法检查
zh-CN.check.freshness.stale: 此备份之后已被修改，旧检查结果已过期。
zh-CN.check.freshness.unknown: 此记录是历史检查证据，当前有效性尚未重新确认。
zh-CN.check.reason.metadata_missing: 必要元数据或清单缺失
zh-CN.check.reason.metadata_invalid: 必要元数据或清单无效
zh-CN.check.reason.unsafe_source: 备份来源包含不支持的路径或对象
zh-CN.check.reason.encrypted_manifest: 目前无法读取加密清单
zh-CN.check.reason.unsupported_records: 清单包含不支持的条目类型
zh-CN.check.reason.invalid_records: 清单包含无效文件编号
zh-CN.check.reason.missing_objects: 清单引用的文件对象缺失
zh-CN.check.reason.source_changed: 检查期间来源发生变化
zh-CN.history.title: 历史恢复点
zh-CN.history.enable: 为这台设备保留历史恢复点
zh-CN.history.cost: 每次备份使用独立工作副本。不支持快速克隆时，100 GB 的备份保留三份可能占约 300 GB，另需工作空间。
zh-CN.history.retention: 含当天，每日保留最后一个正常点。固定点、最新正常基线、旧加密版本和手动留存的数据可能使实际数量超出天数。
zh-CN.history.disableHint: 关闭后停止新增与自动清理，已有点保留到手动删除。再次开启只自动管理新增的点。
zh-CN.history.summary: 已保存 {count} 个点 · 最近 {days} 个自然日
zh-CN.history.summaryOff: 历史功能未开启 · 仍保留 {count} 个点
zh-CN.history.storage: 历史数据：{size}（逻辑大小；共享数据块时实际占用可能更小）
zh-CN.history.unavailable: 部分历史存储不可访问，请连接存储后查看全部恢复点；不会将离线存储当作空目录。
zh-CN.history.busy: 设备任务进行中，暂时无法更改和检查。
zh-CN.history.transition: 历史设置尚未应用完成，请检查存储后重试。
zh-CN.history.manualHint: 历史功能已关闭；已有点仍占用空间，需要手动删除。
zh-CN.history.empty: 还没有恢复点。下一次成功备份会创建恢复点。
zh-CN.history.off: 历史功能默认关闭。可在备份设置中开启，开始保留多个版本。
zh-CN.history.unknownDateHint: 无法确认原始完成时间。导入数据保持为待确认结果，并手动留存。
zh-CN.history.restoreHint: 完整导出后在电脑解压，再使用 Finder 或 Apple Devices 恢复。检查通过不代表已验证真机恢复；整机恢复会覆盖手机上较新的数据。
zh-CN.history.passwordHint: 此点已加密，请保留当时的密码；它可能与当前密码不同。
zh-CN.history.reviewSaveFailed: 检查已结束，但结果未能保存。请检查存储后重试。
zh-CN.history.enableConfirm: 为这台设备保存此策略？独立副本需要额外空间，符合清理条件的旧点会在后续备份时清理。
zh-CN.history.previewCount: 有 {count} 个点将符合自动清理条件。固定和受保护的点继续保留。
zh-CN.history.deleteConfirm: 这会永久删除所选时间点的备份数据，其他点不受影响。
zh-CN.history.deletePin: 此点已固定，删除操作会移除这份受保护的数据。
zh-CN.history.deleteBaseline: 此点是正常基线。删除最后一个兼容基线后，下次需要全量备份。
zh-CN.history.reason.eligible: 符合后续自动清理条件
zh-CN.history.export.ready: 已就绪，请在五分钟内开始下载。
zh-CN.history.export.streaming: 正在传输… 请保持下载连接。
zh-CN.history.export.transferred: 服务端传输已结束，请在电脑上确认下载文件。
zh-CN.history.export.failed: 传输失败，请丢弃不完整文件并重新导出。
zh-CN.history.export.cancelled: 导出已取消，已下载的部分文件不是完整备份。
zh-CN.history.export.expired: 导出会话已过期或服务已重启，请重新导出。
zh-CN.term.pinned.title: 已固定
zh-CN.term.pinned.hint: 不会被自动清理，直到取消固定；仍占用存储空间，也可以明确手动删除。
zh-CN.term.baseline.title: 最新正常基线
zh-CN.term.baseline.hint: 用于准备下一次兼容备份的完整正常备份，即使超过保留天数也会保留。
zh-CN.term.quick.title: 轻量检查
zh-CN.term.quick.hint: 检查完成状态和必要元数据，不逐项读取所有内容，也不证明真机恢复成功。
zh-CN.term.clone.title: 快速克隆
zh-CN.term.clone.hint: 存储支持且通过探测时，可以安全共享未变化的数据块；否则使用独立完整副本。
zh-CN.term.pending.title: 待确认结果
zh-CN.term.pending.hint: 备份工具已完成，但检查发现问题或未完成。结果单独保留，不作为增量基线；重新检查只更新证据。
zh-CN.term.manual.title: 手动留存
zh-CN.term.manual.hint: 关闭历史功能或导入时间未知数据时保留的点，需明确手动删除；重新开启历史后也不会自动清理。
zh-CN.console.settingsHint: 每组单独修改和保存，取消会放弃本组尚未保存的改动。
zh-CN.console.currentDetails: 当前备份详情与文件清单
zh-CN.console.mutableHint: 普通备份会更新这份数据。它不是独立保存的历史恢复点。
zh-CN.console.noCurrent: 尚未找到当前备份；已保留的历史备份仍可单独查看。
zh-CN.console.sourceUnavailable: 当前备份暂不可读取，请检查备份位置和存储连接。
zh-CN.console.openGeneratingJob: 查看生成这份备份的任务
zh-CN.console.browseCurrent: 浏览当前备份的文件清单
zh-CN.console.noLinkedBackup: 没有可定位的关联备份。任务记录与备份数据分别保留。
zh-CN.console.pointMissing: 对应备份已不存在或不可读取；任务记录仍可保留。
zh-CN.console.jobMissing: 对应任务记录已过期或被清理，备份数据不受影响。
zh-CN.console.savedWithIssue: 备份已保存；{phase}发生异常。请查看关联备份和日志。
zh-CN.console.scheduleOn: 已开启 · {start}–{end} · 间隔 {hours} 小时
zh-CN.console.scheduleOff: 未开启 · 计划时间 {start}–{end} · 间隔 {hours} 小时
zh-CN.console.scheduleHint: 按部署时区执行，间隔表示实际经过的时间。
zh-CN.console.pathHint: 修改位置不会自动迁移已有备份。只能使用部署允许的路径。
zh-CN.console.copy.unknown: 复制方式：由实际存储能力决定，目前尚无可靠探测结果。
zh-CN.console.copy.full_copy: 复制方式：独立完整副本。
zh-CN.console.copy.clone: 复制方式：支持写时复制克隆。
zh-CN.console.storageHint: 备份大小合计是逻辑大小，不等于磁盘实际占用。新备份还需要工作空间；容量不足时会停止本次备份，保护已有历史。
zh-CN.console.storageUnavailable: 暂时无法取得可用容量；这不代表剩余空间为零。
zh-CN.console.backupHint: 开始前确认手机在线。手机可能要求解锁或输入锁屏密码授权。
zh-CN.console.deploymentHint: 备份时间窗、页面时间、通知与应用日志统一使用部署时区。更改语言不会改变计划；时区由服务器 TZ 配置管理。
zh-CN.console.recentIssue: 最近一次备份需要关注：{state} 已有备份请见下方。
zh-CN.console.unpinHint: 取消后会重新按适用的保留规则处理，之后可能被自动清理。
zh-CN.notif.testUsesSaved: 测试消息使用已保存的通知设置。
zh-CN.notif.saveBeforeTest: 请先保存修改，再发送测试消息。
zh-CN.notif.loading: 正在加载已保存的通知设置…
zh-CN.notif.loadFailed: 无法加载已保存的设置。请重新加载后再保存或发送测试。
zh-CN.notif.confirmFailed: 无法确认已保存的设置。草稿已保留，请重新保存后再测试。
